skills.title: elaichi
skills.whenToUse: Start here for any Elaichi question — what it is, what its words mean (connection, toolbox, workflow, collection, dashboard, knowledge base), where a screen or setting lives in the app, what each plan includes, and which Elaichi skill to load next. Use when someone asks what Elaichi is, how to do something in it, or where a screen or setting lives, and as the routing table when you are not sure which Elaichi skill covers a question.

skills.title: elaichi-api
skills.whenToUse: Write code against the Elaichi REST API at api.elaichi.ai — API tokens and what they cannot do, the organization header, the cursor list envelope and server-side search, error codes, can_* capability fields, URL conventions, rate limits, and the OpenAPI schema. Use when writing or reviewing code that calls api.elaichi.ai (scripts, integrations, provisioning, or a UI over Elaichi), and read it before constructing the first request.

skills.title: elaichi-automations
skills.whenToUse: Build and run Elaichi workflows (formerly called automations) — "every day at 9", "when X happens, do Y", schedules, triggers, webhooks and approvals. Covers workflow versus synthetic tool, the draft → validate → dry run → publish → enable loop, trigger and step types, runs, sessions, settings, and who can run what. Use when someone wants something to happen on its own — on a schedule, once at a set time, when a webhook, Slack message, collection row or another workflow fires — or is building, debugging, running, sharing or turning off an Elaichi workflow.

skills.title: elaichi-clients
skills.whenToUse: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Microsoft Copilot or any other MCP client to Elaichi — the endpoint, per-client setup, what to tick on the consent screen (scopes, toolboxes), adding a scope later, and why a connected client shows no tools or is missing one. Use when someone is setting up an AI client, pasting the MCP endpoint, editing mcp.json, or reports that their client connected but shows no tools, is missing one, or was refused.

skills.title: elaichi-connections
skills.whenToUse: Connect and look after the accounts Elaichi runs tools against — connect Salesforce, Slack or any app, share versus own, connection status and reconnecting, transferring before someone leaves, what offboarding does to connections, custom connectors, your own OAuth app, and bringing your own remote MCP server. Use when someone is connecting an app account, sharing one with a team, fixing a broken or blocked connection, transferring ownership, offboarding a member, setting up an OAuth app for a connector, adding a remote MCP server, or building a custom connector.

skills.title: elaichi-conventions
skills.whenToUse: Elaichi's base facts in one page — production URLs, API token format and the organization header, the cursor list envelope, error codes, id prefixes (conn_, tbx_, auto_, dash_…), MCP namespaces and scopes, and which Elaichi skill covers which question. Load it whenever calling, configuring or reasoning about anything at api.elaichi.ai or an Elaichi MCP endpoint, before constructing a URL, an id or a paged request, or when an error code needs explaining.

skills.title: elaichi-data
skills.whenToUse: Collections, dashboards and knowledge bases in Elaichi. Use to track records in a shared table or spreadsheet, build a live dashboard, chart or report on it, or keep a knowledge base of docs or a wiki that agents search ("remember this"). Covers which one to pick, building them over MCP, drafts and publishing, public links, and who can see what. Use when someone wants to store or track data, share numbers inside or outside the company, or asks why a widget shows no data or a search found nothing. Also read it before calling any elaichi__collection__*, elaichi__dashboard__* or elaichi__knowledge__* tool.

skills.title: elaichi-governance
skills.whenToUse: Decide and explain who can reach what in Elaichi — the eight built-in roles and 58 permissions, custom roles, restrictions that allow or block connectors and tools, access requests, approvals, the audit log, SSO, SCIM, verified domains and offboarding, and explaining why an action was refused. Use when someone asks who can do what, what a role grants, how access requests or approvals work, how to read the audit log, how to set up SSO, SCIM or domains, or how to offboard someone.

skills.title: elaichi-mcp
skills.whenToUse: Use the Elaichi MCP server well — find a connected tool with search_tools, run it with read_tool, execute_tool or run_code, pick the right account, read a refusal or "restricted" result, ask an admin for access, and work out why a tool is missing. For any MCP client (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Microsoft Copilot and others). Use when an Elaichi MCP server is attached and you need to act on the user's connected apps, or explain why a tool is missing, refused or restricted, or which account to use. Read it before the first search_tools call.

skills.title: elaichi-toolboxes
skills.whenToUse: Build and share toolboxes in Elaichi — pick tools for a job, rename them, lock parameters, stamp from a template, share at "use" (delegation), write the toolbox skill that tells agents how to use it, and build multi-step synthetic tools. Use when someone is building, sharing or debugging a toolbox, template or synthetic tool, deciding between a toolbox and a template, or asks what happens when they share one with a colleague.
